name: Council of AI — framework_readiness
description: A deterministic readiness checklist over one governance framework: eu-ai-act, dora, nis2, gdpr, iso-27001, nist-csf, soc2, pci-dss or cra. For each checklist item the tool returns the published provision it is keyed to (article or clause), a plain-words requirement summary, the evidence that would show readiness for it, and the question it opens for your own compliance function. Optional sector gives a pointer to which of the nine frameworks commonly bind that sector; optional role is echoed for your notes. There is no score, no pass or fail, and no status for the caller: a checklist lays out what evidence would be measured, it does not certify compliance, it is not legal advice, and it is not a conformity assessment. Runs no model, fetches nothing, stores nothing; the same arguments always return the same answer.
